item.title: Thalia Receives Icon Award with Mariachi at Women in Music 2026: ‘It’s About Opening Doors So Others Can Walk Through Them’
item.description:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host begins speaking]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest news and updates from the world of music. Today, we're talking about the 2026 Billboard Women in Music Awards, and one performance that stole the show: Thalia's vibrant musical performance, accompanied by a full mariachi band.
[Short music clip of "Piel Morena" plays in the background]
Host: Thalia, the Mexican superstar, took the stage with a medley of her timeless hits "Piel Morena" and "Amor a la Mexicana". Clad in a bright red dress with a flowing cape, she was joined by guitarists, dancers, and an all-female mariachi group, as well as a large male mariachi ensemble that moved through the aisles amidst the audience.
[Music clip fades out]
Host: Thalia's performance was just the beginning. She was honored with the Icon Award, presented to her by actress and activist Eva Longoria. In her acceptance speech, Thalia thanked Billboard, her family, fans, and everyone who's supported her throughout her career.
[Clip of Thalia's speech plays]
Thalia: "I'm truly, truly blessed to be among this incredible crowd... An icon is a symbol, is a representation of something greater than itself. A story, a culture, a moment in time that lives in people's hearts."
Host: Thalia's speech was a powerful reminder of what it means to be an icon. She dedicated her award to her younger self and to every kid who dares to dream big.
[Clip of Thalia's speech continues]
Thalia: "To every single kid who dares to dream big, do not stop. Your dreams are not big, you're just waiting to grow into them."
Host: Thalia concluded her speech with a message of hope and inspiration, and a shout-out to her Mexican heritage: "¡Viva México! ¡Viva los latinos! Gracias."
[Music clip of "Amor a la Mexicana" plays in the background]
Host: That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time with more news and updates from the world of music.
[Music clip fades out, and the host speaks one last time]
Host: Don't forget to subscribe to our podcast for more engaging stories and updates from the music industry. ¡Hasta luego!
